posts.title_en: Newbie guide part 1 [Stages]
posts.summary_en: Guide by NeO (server 279, 1G220M, stage 250), tiers as of before the 09-23 patch. Early/mid/late cookie tiers, deck types (Scorpion deck, Rapid Fire deck), accuracy targets (850 at Unique/Legendary gear, 1000 at Eternal) and per-boss tactics for Cowardly Cookie, Cool Mint, knockback, airborne, single-burst bosses and the rat trio. Lists the power 'jump' points: gear tiers, 용병단 Lv.3 to 4, TSSR/synergy cookies at 5 stars.

teams.name: Early stage tiers (1-100)

cookies.en: Herb / Devil / Macaron / Pinot Noir / Lime

teams.why: Early on an extra dealer beats a buffer; TSSR stars too low to be efficient. Scorpion & Rye deck or SSR-centred deck.

teams.name: Mid stage tiers (101-200)

cookies.en: Cake Hound / Ion / Dark Choco (high stars)
Milk / Herb / Macaron / Pinot Noir / Pomegranate / Skating Queen

cookies.note: added when boss ATK starts killing cookies

teams.why: After Unique gear the first power jump makes the Rapid Fire deck better than Scorpion; late 100s back to Scorpion deck with manual play.

teams.name: Late stage tiers (201+)

cookies.en: Milk / Herb / Macaron / Pinot Noir / Pomegranate / Skating Queen

teams.why: Eternal gear around 200 gives the second power jump.

builds.thresholds: 명중 ~850 enough at Unique/Legendary gear; ~1000 at Eternal (200+)
builds.why: Accuracy shortfall appears in the late 100s.

mechanics: Power jump points (뻥튀기): gear Epic->Special, Super Epic->Unique, Legendary->Eternal; 용병단 Lv.3->Lv.4; TSSR / synergy cookies at 5 stars (synergy +1).
Mid-game onwards both stages and daily dungeons need manual control.
stage_types: Cowardly Cookie (비겁한 쿠키): Moon Rabbit dedicated (ATK-down debuff, shown as a flame icon under the boss bar). Keep Scorpion glued to stack poison before the Fear; surround the boss so its fire attack is shared; finish with Brightseeker drones/poison during Fear; after Fear, re-engage only once cookies are grouped.

Cool Mint (쿨링민트): either airborne-resist Pinot + 색동주머니 and burst/Scorpion poison in place, or if damage is short go to the left corner, group, release when Cool Mint jumps, regroup and target Cool Mint not adds.
Knockback bosses (e.g. Truck 트럭): early deaths come from no heals; kite the boss until Milk and Herb cast, then group and hit.
Airborne bosses: Pinot Noir + 색동주머니.
Single-burst bosses (e.g. Eagle 독수리): sacrifice Dark Choco to engage and rotate who takes hits; if one-shot, change pets/perks.
Rat trio (쥐새끼 삼형제): luck, or overpower with damage.

quotes.kr: 유니크 레전더리 때는 명중을 850 정도만 챙겨도 충분하다
quotes.en: With Unique/Legendary gear, about 850 accuracy is enough

posts.title_en: My fully-auto Bari deck for stages
posts.summary_en: Full-auto Bari deck at 1.06G (formation screenshot), pushing at 55% with zero control. ATK order Milk > Seeker > Bari > Cherry Cola > Skating Queen. Per-boss notes: adds behind are handled by Bari's buff on Skating Queen; carnivorous plant, Truck and Cowardly are survived thanks to Moon Rabbit; Cool Mint and Hammer (망치) airborne handled by Pinot Noir; Redberry and blob bosses are Bari punching bags. A commenter reports 35% auto at ~60% success; another says on auto Milk is dragged by Bari/Cherry Cola so Brightseeker gets no buff and Oven Wanderer or Cool Mint would be better.

posts.title_en: Don't use Cherry Cola in stage decks unless paired with Bari
posts.summary_en: 연어사 compares his auto deck (from 75540) with a Cherry Cola variant at 275-27 (고장 난 청소봇). His deck keeps formation so Milk's buff reaches everyone except Macaron; Moon Rabbit and Dark Choco split the front-line damage and Moon Rabbit dies only after applying its debuff. With Cherry Cola nobody shares the opening hits, and Cherry Cola runs back alone, gets hit, and drags Milk, so Brightseeker (plus Scorpion and Rye) loses the buff. Links an 'auto deck' post that auto-cleared stages overnight (278-23 -> 286-30 shown).

clears.note: Screenshots show buff formation kept to the clear; one cookie Lv.75 (Pinot), rest Lv.100.

clears.team: Cherry Cola variant (Scorpion deck for manual Cowardly)

teams.why: Milk's buff hits every cookie except Macaron; Moon Rabbit + Dark Choco split tanking; by the time Moon Rabbit dies, Milk and Herb skills are cycling.

mechanics: Milk's buff reaches cookies within the grouped formation; a cookie that runs off (Cherry Cola) pulls Milk along and the back line loses the buff.
stage_types: Cherry Cola is only worth it paired with Bari; post-easing, its burst ceiling matters less.
disagreements: 재킨데: Bari also wrecks formation. Author: Bari/Cherry Cola is a different concept; he can't test it with Bari at 1 star.
One commenter with Seeker 3★ can't push the minor bosses on damage.
